about: The text of the gated MCU images told by who owns it (scripts/lib/text_owner_gate.py, docs/text-ownership.md). Each row holds the image's text and the bytes of every owner of the symbol table of the linked ELF; a change that moves the text or an owner by more than its tolerance moves the row in the same commit, with the reason in `measured`. An owner is the owner of the SYMBOL: code inlined at link time is counted under the symbol that carries it.

zephyr-client-fixed.measured: 2026-10-28, scripts/kit-lane.sh build on the parity tree at origin's round 3818 (the answer path, the Declare dispatch). The first reading of the owners, from the compare build of run 20261028T005644 (text 176,352), put the single-threaded zenoh-pico image's own code at about 55 KB against about 92 KB of wz's own (wz_session_core, c:wz_, wz_session_mcu, wz_codecs, sce_rust_runtime, wz_runtime_coop, keccak, core, compiler_builtins, wz_runtime_zephyr); the platform (the Zephyr network stack, the board's drivers, the toolchain) is the same size in both. `keccak` is the SHAKE128 permutation of the initial sequence number's derivation (src/initial_sn.rs), which zenoh-pico does not carry.
